aspects.says: Card data ends up in stores nobody listed: a message taken out of a persistent queue stays in its file and backups, in a form a plain text scan may miss, so reversals are built from listed fields.
basis: section:13.3. Card Data Ends Up Where Nobody Meant to Store It

aspects.says: A card number is 13 to 19 digits that are not part of a longer run and end in a valid Luhn check digit; a scan's hits are places to look at, and its report is masked.
basis: section:13.2. A Card Number Is Recognised by Its Length and Its Check Digit

aspects.says: A scanner finding is triaged for confirmation, reachability, exposure, exploit conditions, existing controls and change risk, then patched, overridden or deferred with a written risk acceptance.
basis: section:13.5. A Scanner Finding Is a Question, and the Answer Is Written Down

aspects.says: Every person and process in the CDE has its own identity and only the rights it needs, and an AI agent is a privileged component with its own host, identity and read-only rights.
basis: section:13.6. Every Identity in the CDE Is Personal and Limited, an AI Agent's Too
aspects.reason: organisational controls on accounts, hosts and agents that no deterministic test can observe; the quiz's four questions go to the rules a reader is likelier to get wrong

aspects.says: Data protection law covers the same records as PCI DSS and can ask for erasure where retention rules ask to keep; legal decides, and the system must be able to find, export and erase a person's data.
basis: section:13.7. Data Protection Law Covers the Same Records and Can Ask for the Opposite

aspects.says: Each encrypted card number carries the id of its key, so new records use the new key, old ones open through their label until re-encrypted, and the lookup key rotates separately.
basis: section:13.4. A Stored Card Number Names the Key That Opens It

aspects.says: PCI DSS applies to every system that stores, processes or transmits card data and to every system that can reach one or affect its security, so keeping card data out of systems is what makes the scope small.
basis: section:13.1. PCI DSS Covers Every System That Touches Card Data, and Every System That Can Reach One
